definitions.explanation: The act of passing through or along a road, path, or area. Also refers to the traffic or flow of people and vehicles.

examples.japanese: この{道|みち}は{車|くるま}の{通行|つうこう}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This road has heavy vehicle traffic.

examples.japanese: {工事|こうじ}のため{通行止|つうこうど}めになっている。
examples.english: It's closed to traffic due to construction.
examples.notes: 通行止め = road closed, no passage

examples.japanese: {歩行者|ほこうしゃ}の{通行|つうこう}を{妨|さまた}げないでください。
この{橋|はし}は{大|おお}きな{車|くるま}は{通行|つうこう}できない。
examples.english: Large vehicles cannot pass over this bridge.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{一部|いちぶ}の{道路|どうろ}が{通行止|つうこうど}めになった。
examples.english: Some roads were closed to traffic due to the typhoon.

notes:
USAGE: Commonly used in traffic and transportation contexts. Can be used as a noun or as a suru-verb ({通行|つうこう}する = to pass through).

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{通行止|つうこうど}め (road closed, no passage)
・{通行人|つうこうにん} (passerby)
・{通行料|つうこうりょう} (toll, passage fee)
・{通行禁止|つうこうきんし} (no passage, passage prohibited)
・{一方通行|いっぽうつうこう} (one-way traffic)

RELATED WORDS:
・{交通|こうつう} - traffic, transportation (broader meaning)
・{通過|つうか} - passing through (without stopping)
・{往来|おうらい} - coming and going, traffic
